content.rationale: At phase 'opportunity', no IT gate predicate fires. REVIEW_FACTS_IT shows catalog_status='standard' with waiver_present=true, duplicate_capability=false, license_compliant=true, cmdb_record_present=true, technology_eol_months=60 (>=12). The remaining predicates (run_owner_present=false, capacity_headroom_pct=8, change_record_status='missing') are gated on phases build_acceptance/deployment_closure and therefore do not apply at opportunity. TECH_CATALOG and CMDB_EXPORT corroborate standard catalog status and a present CMDB record. No candidate finding applies; disposition GO.

Evaluated the DGF-decision-v8 architecture predicate set against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (v1, age 0 days). Only ARCH-REV-001 fires: reversibility_status = "missing" ("reversibility_status": "missing"), corroborated by LLD-C2052-v3.4 ("Reversibility | missing"), with no exit-plan evidence in admissible inputs (ARCH_DEBT items are all target "Post go-live"; ADR_REGISTER contains only generic "Use governed Azure reference pattern" entries). All other predicates are false: ip_overlap = false and IP_PLAN (authoritative, v2) shows overlap_detected "False" for 10.166.192.0/24, 10.166.193.0/24, 10.166.194.0/24, so ARCH-IP-001 does not apply; api_gateway_required = true AND api_gateway_present = true, so ARCH-API-001 does not apply (Azure API Management appears in HLD); data_owner_present = true with DATA_MODEL data_owner "Samir Meyer-12012-BO", so ARCH-DATA-001 does not apply; measured_latency_ms = 55 <= latency_target_ms = 500, so ARCH-PERF-001 does not apply; business_criticality = "Critical" but architecture_profile multi_az = true, so ARCH-HA-001 does not apply. Per the finding catalog, ARCH-REV-001 is medium severity, action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE, disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, risk_acceptance_allowed = true, so the occurrence resolves to the highest resulting disposition GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, not REWORK. Authorization was exercised via the active standing mandate MANDATE-d3d68264-320d-50e7-bcd1-79409c4b2f8d-BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (authority Lucas Volkov-12012-RO, scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") in an APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS action; approval_reference is required because the disposition is GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS. These are proposed conditions, not completed remediation; the reversibility design must be completed and resubmitted at the next architecture review.

Evaluated the DGF-decision-v8 security predicate set against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (v1, age 0 days, phase = design). Exactly one predicate fires: critical_vulns_open = 2 > 0 ("\"critical_vulns_open\": 2"), which yields SEC-VULN-001 (critical, action REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES, owner Product Team, disposition NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed = false). Corroborated by the authoritative VULN_SCAN (v4): two entries CVE-2026-8000 and CVE-2026-8001 with "severity": "Critical", "status": "Open". All other predicates are false on the snapshot: internet_exposed = true AND waf_present = true, so SEC-WAF-001 does not apply, and WAF_POLICY (v2, authoritative) confirms {"present": true, "mode": "Prevention", "managed_rules": "OWASP"} so SEC-WAF-002 (detection-only) does not apply; data_classification = "Public" is not in (Confidential, Restricted) so SEC-NET-001 does not apply (private_endpoints = false is noted but not triggering under this profile); mfa = "mandatory" so SEC-IAM-001 does not apply (CONDITIONAL_ACCESS: {"mfa": "mandatory", "policy_state": "enabled"}); shared_service_principal = false and IAM_EXPORT shows a single non-shared "ManagedIdentity" principal ("workload-mi", "type": "ManagedIdentity") so SEC-IAM-002 does not apply; logs_to_siem = true and SENTINEL_STATUS confirms {"sentinel": true, "logs_to_siem": true} so SEC-LOG-001 does not apply; SEC-PENTEST-001 is gated on phase == 'build_acceptance' and this occurrence is phase = 'design' (pentest_status = "pass" recorded), so it is not applicable at this phase; key_rotation_days = 60, which is neither None nor 365 (KEYVAULT_CONFIG: "key_rotation_days": 60), so SEC-KEY-001 does not apply. The resulting disposition is the highest-priority outcome in the set, NO_GO. Authorization is required for NO_GO, but the active standing mandate MANDATE-d3d68264-320d-50e7-bcd1-79409c4b2f8d-BUILD-03-SECURITY-1 (authority Lucas Volkov-12012-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings", and SEC-VULN-001 carries risk_acceptance_allowed = false, so no conditional approval or risk acceptance is available for this finding; the two open critical vulnerabilities must be remediated and the gate resubmitted. Upstream BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, ARCH-REV-001) is an architecture-domain finding and contributes no security finding IDs. The unavailable NSG_RULES input was not needed: no fired predicate depends on it, and the snapshot records network_policy = "N/A". These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation.

Evaluated the DGF-decision-v8 tech_readiness predicate set against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot (v1, age 0 days, phase = build_acceptance). Five predicates fire, all yielding REWORK-class outcomes: (1) TR-RESTORE-001 — restore_tested = false (\"restore_tested\": false), corroborated by authoritative RESTORE_TEST (v2) {\"tested\": \"False\"}; because the elif branch is gated on a successful restore test, no TR-RTO-001 is raised even though measured_restore_hours = 24.0 equals target_rto_hours = 24. (2) TR-RPO-001 — measured_data_loss_minutes = 84 > target_rpo_minutes = 60, corroborated by RESTORE_TEST {\"measured_data_loss_minutes\": \"84\", \"target_rpo_minutes\": \"60\"}; this predicate is independent of restore_tested. (3) TR-LOAD-001 — load_test_pct_of_peak = 50 < 100, corroborated by authoritative LOAD_TEST (v5) {\"peak_test_pct\": \"50\"}. (4) TR-CODE-001 — critical_static_findings = 1 > 0, corroborated by authoritative CI_PIPELINE (v2) {\"critical_static_findings\": 1}. (5) TR-BLOCKER-001 — open_blockers = 3 > 0. Non-firing predicates: backup_enabled = true (BACKUP_JOBS v5: {\"enabled\": \"True\", \"job\": \"daily-backup\", \"last_status\": \"Succeeded\"}), so TR-BACKUP-001 does not apply; dr_required = false (FAILOVER_TEST v2: {\"dr_required\": \"False\"}) so TR-DR-001 does not apply, consistent with the HLD \"single_region_multi_az\" / \"No cross-region failover\"; runbook_status = \"approved\" AND on_call_defined = true AND handover_signed = true, so TR-OPS-001 does not apply; rollback_tested = true (ROLLBACK_TEST v4: {\"rollback_tested\": \"True\", \"result\": \"PASS\"}) so TR-ROLLBACK-001 does not apply. The highest-priority resulting disposition is REWORK. Authorization is not required: REWORK is not in authorization_required_for (only GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), and the standing mandate MANDATE-d3d68264-320d-50e7-bcd1-79409c4b2f8d-BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1 (scope \"all and only risk-acceptable findings\") is not exercised. Upstream decisions contribute no tech_readiness finding IDs: BUILD-01-IT-1 (GO, no findings), BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 (ARCH-REV-001, architecture domain), BUILD-03-SECURITY-1 (SEC-VULN-001, security domain, NO_GO). These are proposed remediation actions, not completed remediation; the gate must be resubmitted once the restore test, recovery point, peak load test, static findings and open blockers are resolved.
